item.title: Autonomy in Action: Advancing CBRN Defense Capabilities with Unmanned Systems
item.description: Our Nation’s warfighters encounter many known and unknown hazards on the modern battlefield including chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear (CBRN) threats. item.title: Marine Corps Launches New Drone Training Program
